items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: "He said, 'You know Chu Berry?' I says, 'Namewise,' I says, 'Yeah.'"

ctx.x: Why did he feel that their styles (inaudible)?

Well, you know, like -- you know, Ben was better for ballads, actually, you know what I mean? When you really get into them swing things, he worked out his solos like with "Cotton Tail" and things like that. That was great. But he didn't feel like he just could stand there and Chu was playing really too many notes, he figured, for him. You know, Herschel didn't play that many notes, you know.
Right. Were you -- did they know at that time that you played Herschel ---style?
